context: Ren interviews a researcher on study methods.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: academic interview; vocabulary (含む/単位/基づい/主体/想定) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 研究は、何を主体に進めますか?
lines.en: What do you center your research on?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm curious focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 事実を主体に、進めます。
lines.style: composed researcher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 結論は、何に基づきますか?
lines.style: curious young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 十分なデータに基づいて、出します。
lines.en: I draw them based on sufficient data.
lines.style: patient researcher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 想定と違う結果は、扱いますか?
lines.en: Do you treat results that differ from expectations?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 想定外も、論文に含みます。
lines.en: I include the unexpected in the paper too.
lines.style: composed researcher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: データの単位は、統一するんですか?
lines.en: Do you unify the data units?
lines.style: thoughtful young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 単位を統一して、想定を検証します。
lines.en: I unify units and verify the assumptions.
lines.style: warm researcher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
